integrity: The continuous-time assertions are established analytically; symbolic and numerical checks are supplementary; historical priority and independent scientific auditing remain unverified.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric homogeneous competitive graph system, one universal hub, disjoint peripheral cliques, strictly positive initial populations, 0<coupling<1; clique-merger operations change peripheral degrees; no arbitrary-graph or stochastic conclusions. Broader pre-existing equilibrium theory may imply special cases.
title: Sharp coexistence and critical hub extinction under clique coarsening
